capabilities: edit .tex files in a live rendered view with formulas, theorem blocks and reference chips
compile locally and preview the PDF with bidirectional source/PDF navigation
configure custom template visualization profiles and environment/command rules
explore proof-reference graphs built from \ref calls
export a self-contained HTML reading edition
disambiguation: Not a Markdown math preview tool; it edits .tex project files and compiles them with an installed TeX distribution.
extras: Desktop only (no iPad editing); requires Obsidian 1.13.7+. Manifest notes the plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Shell escape and YOLO AI completion are off by default; the README warns YOLO may send writing context to its configured model provider. HTML export does not support LuaLaTeX.
intentEvidence: Advantages over Overleaf for individual writing
problem: Obsidian has no way to work on real LaTeX projects with local compilation, a synced PDF preview, and rendered mathematics while editing the source.

relations.evidence: Advantages over Overleaf for individual writing
Optional YOLO completion is off by default. Enabling it uses the separate YOLO plugin
With LaTeX Suite enabled, its snippets also expand in LaTeX documents

requires.name: local TeX distribution (TeX Live, MacTeX, pdfLaTeX/XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX)

summary: Live LaTeX editor for .tex projects that compiles with a local TeX distribution, shows a native PDF preview, and renders formulas and theorem blocks in place.
